page.layout: One page of text in a single column; a running head at the top; no marginal notes; a dedication signature block centred below the text; a small signature line at the bottom left.

main_text.p: guum vivendi mortalibus,immenfum gloriæ Principibus, scrò conficere iubet. De cætero, quia, quantum in Vobis fitum,admonitimini, ut quandocunq; concefleritis, cum laude & bonis recordationibus facta atq; famam nominis vestri subditi memorent; non est quoq; quod dubitetis, Celsissime, manuras Vos semper in animis hominum, in æternitate temporum, fama rerum. Inglorios & ignobiles oblivio obruet; Principes pofteritati narratæ, & tradiæ, superstites erunt. Sic sperat sovet, spondet
main_text.head: Illustrissimarum Celsitudinum Vestrarum

page.notes: The page is a dedication; the first line reads "guum" (for "quum" or "cum"), printed as shown. Some words are damaged by stains and show-through, notably "manuras", "admonitimini", "sperat sovet" and "spondet", which may be misprinted or partly illegible. Page number is not printed.
